source.origin: Verilog twin of ofdm32_mod_1r1w: upstream logikbench TX (as in ofdm32_mod_upstream, same RTLScout-marked edits) behind a 1R/1W wrapper FSM
source.design: flexible-schedule OFDM transmitter (QAM map -> IFFT -> CP) behind a 1r1w memory port; TB_CYCLES/TB_READS/TB_WRITES scored
source.oracle: harness content-checks the 80 output sample words against goldens captured from the upstream RTL's TX at the loopback tap (see validation/ofdm/gen_split_vectors.py); every sample depends on all carriers, so no pass-through shortcut exists (fixes the loopback benchmark's identity degeneracy); no CEC (schedule is free)
